name: Cascante (Spain)
description: Sky blue field charged at the centre with the crowned arms of the city of Cascante (a castle on blue within a bordure inscribed CIVITAS CASCANTUM MUNICIPIUM ROMANORUM).
history: The flag of the municipality of Cascante is a rectangular cloth of proportion 2/3, sky blue, with the arms in their tinctures at the centre; the arms are azure, a castle or, with a bordure argent bearing a cross potent or and the legend Civitas Cascantum · Municipium Romanorum.

features.role: Cascante arms — castle on blue within an inscribed bordure with a cross potent
castle and crown of the arms
